page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and a bundled 3839 GB local SSD storage volume. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance profile. Single-core performance is a notable tradeoff, with stress-ng single-core CPU and single-threaded gzip compression tests registering in the weak category, placing in the bottom 25%. However, multi-core capabilities are more robust, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores all performing in the average tier. Memory bandwidth tests, including both small-block cached and large-block uncached read and write operations, consistently place in the average range.

Given the combination of 128.0 GB RAM and a substantial 3839 GB local SSD, this server offers high resource density for storage-heavy and memory-intensive workloads. It is well-suited for database operations, Redis deployments, and static web serving, where its average multi-core and database benchmark performance can be leveraged. The qualitative cost efficiency is favorable for applications requiring large local storage footprints and moderate compute power, though it is less optimal for single-threaded or compute-bound tasks due to its weaker single-core performance.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.4xlarge is an x86_64 server featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor, 128.0 GB of RAM, and a bundled 3839 GB local SSD. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. Performance benchmarks show a distinct tradeoff: single-core CPU execution and single-threaded gzip compression are weak, placing in the bottom 25%, while multi-core CPU, memory bandwidth, and database operations perform in the average tier. With a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and significant local SSD capacity, this instance is optimized for storage-intensive and database workloads. It is highly suitable for database hosting, Redis caching, and static web serving, offering a balanced resource profile for data-heavy applications that do not require high single-threaded compute performance.
